desc: The absolute rarest Pokemon in existence. Very few players will ever obtain these.

pokemons.name: Pikachu (Detective 2019)
pokemons.desc: Detective Pikachu was first available at an event in 2019, and the 2023 rerun featured a very similar looking but technically different costume with a unique dex entry. While this newer version was shiny eligible, the older 2019 one was not intended to be, but due to an oversight, there was an extremely small window of about half an hour where they could be shiny. There have only been two confirmed cases of people encountering a shiny in this way, making this Pokemon one of the rarest in existence.

pokemons.name: GO Fest Costume Lugia
pokemons.desc: The rarity specifically applies to costume Lugia, which is visually identical to a regular Lugia, except the game treats it as a costume. This was only obtainable for attendees of GO Fest 2017 in Chicago and has a met date of 26/07/2017. Due to its exclusivity and novelty, it is very sought after by some collectors.

pokemons.name: Gardevoir (Meloetta-inspired Hat)
pokemons.desc: Currently, this shiny Gardevoir with a hat is the only one of its kind. At its initial release, Meloetta hat Gardevoir was not shiny eligible. However, the special research from this event awarded an encounter, and if this encounter was saved and triggered after Gardevoir was made shiny eligible (for Mega Gardevoir Raid Day), then it too could become shiny.

pokemons.name: Stakataka (Ultra Wormhole Background)
pokemons.desc: Stakataka and Blacephalon were not shiny eligible at the time of GO Fest 2024 when this background was available in raids. However, due to an error where remote raids did not correctly reward backgrounds, Niantic provided affected players with a research containing make-up encounters which would have the background. If this research was saved for after their shiny debut, then it was possible for the encounters to be shiny. Recently, it has been revealed that some players have discovered how to use hacks to add this research to their account retroactively. Please be mindful of this if you intend to trade for one.

pokemons.name: Mew
pokemons.desc: Mythical Pokemon cannot be traded inside of GO (except for Meltan and Melmetal). However, some players may be interested in transferring them to Pokemon HOME, where they can be traded and moved into Pokemon console games. Shiny Mew has been available twice and paywalled behind the Masterwork research, making it reasonably rare to come by. Note that you can only obtain one per account, and if you send it to HOME, it isn't possible to get another.

pokemons.name: Celebi

Note that you can only obtain one per account, and if you send it to HOME, it isn't possible to get another.
